title: Participating in Meetings

questions.prompt: I'd like to suggest ___ the schedule.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

questions.explanation: 'Have we considered...?' uses have + past participle. The form is 'considered'.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

questions.explanation: 'From my perspective' introduces your view. 'To sum things up' introduces a summary.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

questions.prompt: One concern I have is ___ we may need more time.
questions.explanation: Use 'that + subject + verb' after 'One concern I have is'.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

options: Another option would be to extend the deadline.
Another option would be to extending the deadline.
questions.explanation: Use 'would be to + base verb': would be to extend, not would be to extending.
questions.hint: Read each option as a complete sentence before choosing.

application.prompt: Your team has a difficult deadline. Suggest a solution, acknowledge a colleague, and confirm the next step.
checklist: I used a useful expression from these lessons.
I compared the meaning with the example; my wording can be different.
application.modelResponse: I see your point, and I agree that we need more time. I'd like to suggest finishing the urgent section first. Before we proceed, could we confirm who will check it?

completionRule: Attempt all five questions and review explanations

introduction.en: Practice making suggestions, sharing opinions, expressing concerns, and confirming decisions.
introduction.taglish: Balikan ang suggestions, opinions, concerns, at pag-confirm ng decisions.
introduction.fil: Balikan ang pagmumungkahi, pagbabahagi ng opinyon, pagsasabi ng alalahanin, at pagkumpirma ng pasya.
